messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — AcmeX goes live Thurs EOD. I want to ship a small set of coachmarks + a targeted warm pool to reduce early errors and capture feedback. Can we run a 48h cadence for activation + a minimal prefill?

rahul_csm: +1. Recommended quick runbook:
- Day0: prefill 10 unique prompt sequences, enable prefix caching for tenant, stagger warm-pool scale over 15m.
- Day1: automated 48h check-in, capture first-touch NPS, collect top 10 failure prompts.
- Fallback: if latency > 250ms P95, fall back to smaller model variant + throttle.

olivia_tse: Add to that — include one eval set (10 prompts) that exercises slot-filling and a tool call. We should surface any semantic regressions to product via the feedback tag.

maria_cs: Good — can you paste the prefill command we should run? I'll own execution. @warmup-bot can you help schedule? :calendar:

warmup-bot: Deploy scheduled: warm pool "acmex-warm" -> start 2024-11-14T16:00:00Z, target size 3, ramp 0->3 over 15m. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/warmpools/acmex-warm

rahul_csm: Sample prefill curl:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.redwood-inference/v1/prefill 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDBOX_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"tenant":"acmex","sequences":[{"prompt":"welcome_flow_1","count":4},{"prompt":"slot_fill_test","count":6}],"cache_policy":"prefix","target_pool":"acmex-warm"}'
```
Note: keep sequences small (<128 tokens) to warm kv cache efficiently.

ben_pm: What's the signal for early renewal risk we should surface to AMs?

olivia_tse: Track these during day0-7: high error rate for >=5% of calls, repeated partial completions on slot-fill prompts, and NPS <=6 at 48h check-in. Tag tenant with "renewal-risk" in the runbook when any condition hits.

maria_cs: I'll run the prefill at 09:00 PT tomorrow and post results here. After prefill, we'll run the eval set and attach diffs.

cs-runbook-bot: Runbook snapshot: https://docs.internal.redwood/cs/runbooks/activation-coachmarks-v1 — includes checklist: prefill cmd, eval prompts, feedback form URL, rollback steps.

rahul_csm: Quick rollback snippet if warm pool causes higher cost/latency:
```bash
# scale down warm pool immediately
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.redwood-inference/v1/warmpools/acmex-warm/scale 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDBOX_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"target":0}'
```
Then set model routing to fallback variant: route_policy: latency-first -> model: small-quantized-v2.

maria_cs: Thx — will capture results and a short retrospective. Anyone want to co-review the coachmark copy before I push?

olivia_tse: I can do a quick pass after your run. If you paste the copy here I’ll comment inline.

maria_cs: Will do. Planning to include: 1) quick intro to capabilities, 2) expected input examples, 3) how to report issues (feedback form link). Short + punchy. :memo:

ben_pm: Also add subtle CTA for the 48h call — sets expectation and increases conference rate.

maria_cs: Agreed. I'll post the copy and the prefill results in this thread after execution. Happy to loop AMs if the 48h NPS <=6.

warmup-bot: Prefill job submitted: job_id=pf-20241114-001, status=queued.

maria_cs: Awesome — thanks team.
